title: Associate Business Support Specialist
description:
Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We-re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that's welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Overview As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing's team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company's core values of safety, quality and integrity. Technology for today and tomorrow The Boeing India Engineering Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge RD, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace. People-driven culture At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts - enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected.-No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people's careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing. With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace. About Position / Position Summary The responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following: Implement innovative principles of Space planning in tune with Business requirement Orienting the new joiners with Boeing India and BGES- Global workplace strategy and operations function Responsible for all Employee services including but not limited to Food, transport, vending, events, telecommunications etc. Maintaining excellent relationships with various Business Units (BU) taking care of any related business requirements. Engage with BU's and proactively anticipate business requirements Coordinating with Landlord to ensure smooth building operations Should be able to manage all technical services including equipment maintenance required to operate facility and always ensure 100% uptime of services. Manages and support integration of activities like facilities occupation including facilities planning, analysis, project administration, property administration, facilities provisioning as required from time to time Should have managed small and large projects. Ability to lead and manage small minor project works on-site. Will be responsible for facility takeover from Project team which includes snagging / de-snagging / track and maintain all facility related documentation etc. Responsible for Asset management i.e. end to end life cycle of an asset until disposal taking care of quarterly/annual physical verification of assets. Responsible for complete Procure to Pay cycle (P2P) coordinating with relevant business partners(s) Responsible for ensuring safety security at workplace and implementation of Employee Health and Safety policies Ability to collaborate with other functions like Global Real Estate/Finance/HR/Security etc as when required to deliver the assigned scope of work. Responsible for representing BGES- Global workplace strategy and operations for various audits like Quality/ISO/BCP including recertification(s) Sharing input on annual budget allocation tracking planned vs actual spent along with proper reasoning of deviations (if any). Monitor emergency response procedures such as dialogic/call tree/ERT members. Manage end-to-end site operations with special focus on driving value through service delivery improvements, cost saving initiatives etc. Should have knowledge of required permits to maintain compliant facility operations. Ability to ideate, develop, lead and execute operational excellence projects. Plan and manage operational budgets. This role will be based out of Bengaluru, India. Position Responsibilities: This is a position for an Associate Business Support Specialist located in Bangalore and in support of the Boeing Global Enterprise Services - Global Workplace and strategy organization.-The position will report to the Business Support Manager and will receive day-to-day directions from this manager.-The candidate will work closely with local agencies and vendors to proactively support the business needs related to Boeing personnel because of emerging business needs. This includes but is not limited to Boeing infrastructure (office facilities), employee services, and safety and security (disaster planning and business continuity) within the assigned location, payment process for vendors. Candidate should have good command over English language. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Entrepreneurial mindset. Ability to foster two-way collaboration. Ability to facilitate decision making. Proactive risk management. Effective Communicator with good verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of advanced Microsoft office tool. Intermediate analytical skills. People Management with good inter interpersonal skills. Quick learner has eye for detail. Customer focused. Capability to manage and lead teams. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): 5-10years of relevant experience in site operations, business operations, Integrated Facilities Management (IFM), Shared Services, or an administrative environment. Graduate / equivalent qualification in hospitality, administration, engineering, operations
will be preferred. Previous work experience with multinationals in similar environments. Typical Education Experience: Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 5 Plus years' related work experience or master's degree with 5+ years of experience with-n equivalent combination of education and experience. Relocation: This position does offer relocation within INDIA. 
 Applications for this position will be accepted until Oct. 22, 2026 
 Export Control Requirements: This is not an Export Control position. Relocation This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility. Visa Sponsorship Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status. Shift Not a Shift Worker (India) 
 Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law. We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world's most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

title: Canada- Model validation RFP
description:
The Model Risk Management (MRM) provides oversight for the MRM Framework, which consists of the policy, processes, and procedures. The Quant Analyst - Model Risk Management (MRM) will be responsible for conducting independent model validations for the assigned models to ensure models align with business objectives and design objectives. Verify that models are performing as expected, identify potential limitations, which includes assessing potential impact. Perform annual reviews and review the on-going monitoring reports to ensure that the models are performing as intended. Key Responsibilities Comprehensive Model Validation: Conduct thorough and comprehensive validations of various model components, ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and aligned with the intended business objectives and regulatory requirements. This includes but is not limited to: Model Inputs Analysis: Apply data analysis techniques to assess the quality, integrity, and appropriateness of data used in the models. Examine data extraction, cleaning, transformation processes, and evaluate data-related assumptions and limitations. Model Conceptual Evaluation: Scrutinize the model design and construction, verifying the suitability of the modeling framework and theory for the intended use. Review model segmentation, variable selection, model testing procedures, and evaluation model assumptions, limitations, and risks. Model Code Review and Replication: Review model code to ensure correctness, accuracy, and absence of material errors. Collaborate with model developers to address any identified issues. Outcomes Analysis: Assess both in-sample and out-of-sample back test results; evaluate sensitivity and scenario testing, stress testing, benchmark model development, and quantitative and business performance metrics. Challenger Model Development (if required) Risk Identification and Mitigation: Provide effective challenges and identify potential model risks. Recommend appropriate mitigation measures and enhancements to improve model quality and compliance with regulatory standards. Ongoing Monitoring and Outcome Analysis: Assess the mechanisms for ongoing model performance monitoring, issue identification, and risk management to ensure effective oversight, policy compliance. Ensure that the model remains reliable, relevant, and compliant throughout its lifecycle, this includes review risk mitigation measures, compensating controls, and risk acceptances. Documentation and Reporting: Produce high-quality, comprehensive validation reports that clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and potential risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure that validation documentation adheres to internal standards and regulatory requirements (SR11-7). Review and upgradation of MRM policies and Procedures annually, with new trends Audit and Regulatory Review Support: Assist in gathering and providing materials requested by internal audit and regulators, drafting responses to questions, and defending validations in exams. Continuous Learning and Improvement: Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in model validation and regulatory requirements. Contribute to the enhancement of the model validation framework by suggesting process improvements and implementing industry-leading methodologies. Develop and maintain model governance documentation and performance monitoring, including periodically presenting results to MRM stakeholders. Interact with all key stakeholders including model users, model owners, vendors, Model Risk Governance, and other Validators throughout the model lifecycle including validation, ongoing performance evaluation. Build relationships across model owners, data scientists, Model Risk Management, Audit, and third-party vendors. Use subject matter expertise and analytics to proactively identify and address gaps and identify emerging risks. Contribute towards remediation efforts for model-related issues identified through exams, audits, and model validations.

title: Senior Platform Hardware Design Engineer
description:
Job Details: Position Overview As a Platform Hardware Design Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, design, integration, bring-up, and validation of complex platform hardware. You will drive hardware development end-to-end, translating high level system requirements into detailed circuit and component specifications and leading designs from architecture and schematic development through PCB implementation, board power-on, debugging, validation, and delivery. You will be expected to make platform level technical decisions, resolve complex and ambiguous multidisciplinary problems, lead critical design reviews, drive cross-functional alignment, mentor engineers, and influence hardware development practices across projects. Our Business Group You will be joining the Silicon and Platform Engineering Group (SPE), an organization at Intel committed to advancing Intels mission of delivering world-class silicon and platform solutions. The group focuses on developing integrated systems that align with customer needs and support Intels broader goals of leadership in technology innovation. SPE collaborates across diverse domains to ensure Intel platforms meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements. Our work sits at the intersection of silicon, board hardware, firmware, validation, signal and power integrity, mechanical and thermal engineering, PCB technology, manufacturing, and system integration. Our senior hardware engineers have a broader responsibility than executing an individual design. They help establish platform architecture, guide implementation, identify and qualify appropriate hardware solutions, provide technical leadership during board power-on and debug, and lead resolution of schematic, layout, SI/PI, and hardware issues. Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture and End-to-End Technical Ownership - Own complex platform-board designs from requirements and architecture through deployment. - Translate high level platform and silicon requirements into system architecture, circuit level requirements, component specifications, and PCB implementation requirements. - Define and drive critical platform architecture decisions encompassing high speed interfaces, memory, power delivery, clocking, resets, sequencing, control, management, and validation functionality. - Lead design trade-offs across electrical performance, SI/PI, thermal and mechanical constraints, board complexity, reliability, manufacturability, component availability, cost, schedule, and system compatibility. - Establish clear technical direction where platform requirements or implementation approaches are initially ambiguous. Advanced Board Design and Technical Leadership - Lead development of complex high density, multilayer PCBs incorporating advanced digital, analog, mixed signal, and power circuitry. - Own or provide technical leadership for schematic design, component selection, interface definition, PCB implementation, and design verification. - Establish PCB stack-up, placement, routing, impedance, power distribution, and critical interface requirements in collaboration with layout and analysis teams. - Lead schematic, layout, and technical design reviews and ensure critical findings are driven to closure. - Guide engineers and layout teams in resolving challenging schematic, PCB, layout, and design-for-X issues. - Identify and qualify new hardware solutions and reusable design approaches where appropriate. High-Speed Design and SI/PI - Apply deep understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, transmission-line behavior, high-speed interfaces, and platform power delivery to architecture and implementation decisions. - Partner with SI/PI engineers to establish design constraints and evaluate critical interfaces and power delivery networks. - Review PCB implementations for stack-up, placement, routing, return path continuity, high speed performance, and advanced SI/PI considerations. - Use modeling, simulation, measurement, and hardware correlation to guide technical decisions as appropriate. Power Architecture and Power Delivery - Define and review platform power delivery architecture, voltage regulation, sequencing, power budgeting, and power distribution networks. - Evaluate board and system power delivery tradeoffs, considering electrical performance, transient behavior, PCB implementation, and platform requirements. - Work with power integrity specialists to assess PDN behavior and drive required design improvements. - Apply simulation and hardware measurement to correlate power delivery behavior and resolve platform issues. Board Bring-up, System Integration and Debug - Define and lead power-on, bring up, validation, characterization, and debug strategy for complex platform hardware. - Lead resolution of difficult issues spanning board hardware, silicon, firmware, high-speed interfaces, power delivery, and system integration. - Use disciplined root cause analysis to diagnose failures and define corrective actions. - Provide hands-on technical leadership in the lab during critical power-on, bring up, and debug activities. - Apply appropriate measurement techniques and laboratory equipment for high speed, low speed, clock, power, and digital/analog circuitry. - Drive problems across engineering boundaries until technical closure. Program and Cross-functional Leadership - Serve as a senior technical interface across silicon, firmware, validation, SI/PI, mechanical, thermal, PCB layout, manufacturing, suppliers, and program teams. - Lead technical discussions and design reviews and communicate risks, tradeoffs, recommendations, and design decisions clearly to stakeholders. - Identify technical and execution risks early and drive mitigation plans. - Own technical readiness for critical hardware milestones, including design release, fabrication, assembly, power-on, and validation. - Develop and improve reusable architectures, review methodologies, design checklists, development flows, and engineering practices. - Mentor engineers through architecture development, schematic and PCB reviews, bring-up, debug, and technical problem solving. - Influence technical decisions and engineering practices beyond an individual board or project. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications
 - Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
 - 6+ years significant hands-on industry experience in complex platform hardware, PCB development, or system hardware engineering.
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex board designs from architecture and requirements through schematic design, PCB implementation, bring-up, debug, and validation.
 - Deep understanding of digital and analog board design, electrical interfaces, mixed-signal fundamentals, and system architecture.
 - Strong knowledge of high speed interfaces, transmission line behavior, signal integrity, power integrity, memory, clocking, reset, sequencing, and power delivery.
 - Proven experience with PCB technologies and layout techniques, including stack-up, placement, routing, and advanced SI/PI considerations. 
 - Advanced experience with schematic capture and PCB design/review environments.
 - Strong hands-on laboratory experience and demonstrated ability to diagnose complex board level problems, determine root cause, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to analyze board/system level design tradeoffs and make sound technical decisions.
 - Ability to independently lead complex technical development activities and drive issues across multiple engineering functions.
 - Strong technical documentation, presentation, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring capability.
Preferred Qualifications
 - Extensive experience designing complex compute, server, client, FPGA-based, semiconductor validation or other high performance platform hardware.
 - Experience with high speed I/O and memory technologies such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB, or comparable interfaces.
 - Deep understanding of PCB stack-up, placement, routing, high speed design, transmission lines, signal integrity, crosstalk, power integrity, and PDN design.
 - Experience applying SI/PI, power, circuit, or electromagnetic simulation to board architecture and design decisions.

A non-clinical career opportunity for BDS graduates combining Clinical Knowledge + Healthcare Management + Customer Success + Relationship Management + Business Operations + CRM & Marketing Support. 
 Please Note: This role is based at our Corporate Office and does not involve independent patient consultations or routine dental practice.
 Employment Details: 
 Post / Designation - Associate Clinical Relations & Management 
 Role - Clinical Relations and Business Coordination 
 Work Location - Yelahanka, Attur Layout, Bengaluru. 
 Working Days & Timings - Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Sunday weekly off. 
 Field / Travel - Medical camps, professional events and branch/field visits, as required. 
 Annual CTC - 2,40,000 to 4,30,000 annual, CTC, based on experience and suitability, plus applicable performance-linked incentives / bonus. 
 Joining - Immediate / early joiners preferred. 
 Qualification / Requirement - BDS - Mandatory. 
 Eligibility / Experience - Fresher to 3 years with Valid DCI Registration - Preferred. 
 Clinical / Healthcare Exposure - Preferred, not mandatory. MBA / PGDM - Advantage. Patient / Customer Interaction - Preferred. Relevant Certificate Course - Added Advantage. CRM / Relationship Management Exposure - Added advantage 
 Key Responsibilities & Role Purpose 1. Patient Relationship & Experience - Manage patient recalls and follow-ups, provide necessary coordination and support, and help ensure a smooth and positive patient experience. 2. Treatment Follow-up & Conversion - Follow up and coordinate with the clinical team to encourage continuation of pending treatments and improve treatment acceptance. 3. Dentist Relationship Management - Build and maintain professional relationships with dentists and support their ongoing engagement with the Supplies division . 4. Product & Commercial Coordination - Coordinate product enquiries, quotations, follow-ups and product demonstrations, while supporting new dentist customers during their initial engagement with Supplies Division. 5. Dentist Customer Support & Retention - Support dentist customers with product-related queries and follow-ups, helping ensure a smooth service experience and continued engagement with Metier Dental Supplies. 6. CRM & Records Management - Maintain accurate CRM records of patients and dentist customers, including interactions and follow-ups. 7. Clinical Content Support for Digital Marketing - Use clinical knowledge to support accurate and relevant healthcare content for digital marketing activities. 8. Medical Camps & Outreach Activities - Participate in and support the coordination of medical camps, health awareness programmes and other physical outreach activities . 9. Professional & Educational Engagement - Support and participate in webinars, clinical education programmes, dentist interaction sessions, workshops and professional healthcare events. 
 Preferred Skills & Competencies Clear communication and interpersonal skills. Good relationship-building and customer-handling ability. Good coordination, organization and follow-up skills. Comfortable with presentations and professional interactions. Working knowledge of MS Office; familiarity with Google Workspace / CRM is an advantage. Proactive, responsible, detail-oriented and willing to learn. 
 Why Join Us? Build a long-term career in healthcare management beyond conventional clinical practice. Gain cross-functional exposure across Clinics, Dental Supplies and Healthcare Marketing. Work closely with founders and leadership on real healthcare business initiatives. Develop practical exposure to customer success, relationship management and business operations. If you are a BDS graduate looking to build a career in healthcare beyond conventional clinical practice, we would like to hear from you. 
 About Us: -Metier Dental Solutions and Healthcare Services is a growing healthcare organization operating across Multispeciality dental & polyclinics, dental supplies, healthcare outreach and allied healthcare initiatives .We are building an integrated healthcare ecosystem focused on quality care, ethical practices, professional relationships and sustainable growth.

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
Job Description 
 EdgeQ is looking for talented Design Verification Engineers across experience levels to join our verification team working on complex semiconductor designs for 5G/6G, edge computing, and networking applications. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building robust verification environments and ensuring high-quality silicon through comprehensive IP, SoC, and post-silicon verification. The role covers verification at IP, subsystem, SoC, and post-silicon levels. 

 Responsibilities 
 Develop and execute verification strategies for digital IPs, subsystems, and complete SoCs. Develop testbenches, test scenarios, sequences, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, and functional coverage. Work with System Verilog and UVM to build scalable and reusable verification environments. Verify complex data paths, control logic, memories, interfaces, and system-level functionality. Perform block, IP, subsystem, and SoC-level verification including integration and system-level scenarios. Debug simulation, formal, emulation, FPGA, and silicon issues and work closely with design and architecture teams. Drive functional and code coverage closure and identify verification gaps. Develop automation and verification infrastructure to improve regression, debug, and overall verification efficiency. Support pre-silicon verification, silicon bring-up, post-silicon validation, and debug activities. 

 Required Skills 
 Strong fundamentals in digital design and computer architecture. Hands-on experience with Verilog/System Verilog and verification methodologies. Experience with System Verilog/UVM-based verification environments. Good understanding of constrained-random verification, assertions, functional coverage, and regression. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Experience with ASIC/SoC verification flows. Verify low-power designs and power-management features using UPF, including power domains, isolation, retention, power states, and power sequencing. 

 Good to Have 
 Experience with any of the following - 5G/6G, RISC-V, O-RAN/eCPRI, JESD204, Ethernet, PCIe/CXL, UCIe, SerDes, Network-on-Chip (NoC), DSP/data path verification, low-power verification, formal verification, emulation/FPGA validation, or post-silicon debug. 

 Education 
 B.Tech/M.Tech/M.S. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, VLSI, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

title: EYP-Complex Securities-Associate Manager
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Senior Analyst - Complex Securities As part of our EY-Valuations team, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment and complex securities The opportunity We are looking for Senior Analysts with expertise in Quantitative Finance and Complex Securities Valuation to join EY-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development Your key responsibilities Demonstrated an aptitude in the quantitative and qualitative analyses of financial instruments, including options, warrants, fixed income securities, and other derivatives. Knowledge of numerical techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation, lattice techniques, and finite difference methods. Knowledge of valuation of instruments like incremental borrowing rate (IBR), Employee Stock Options (ESOPS), Total Shareholder Return (TSR), Convertible Bonds, Bonds with embedded options etc. Strong derivative pricing and financial modelling skills, with the ability to create both valuation and financial models based on a description of a client s derivative financial asset or operational and financial business plan. Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Identify issues and propose strategies related to the procedures executed. Assume a steering role in report generation and detailed financial modelling. Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with EY offices globally. Demonstrate teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members. Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided. Identify business development opportunities and assist Partners and Senior Managers on proposals and new business opportunities. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments relevant to our as well as the clients business. Skills and attributes for success Excellent thoughtfulness, project management, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills Experience in designing algorithms and developing code for pricing and valuing complex financial instruments CFA and FRM Candidate Wel versed with Python (Mandatory), C++ and MATLAB (Desirable) Experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking and Corporate Finance Experience in financial modelling, including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred Advanced knowledge and experience in any of the following sectors will be added advantage - Financial Services, Oil and Gas, Technology, Consumer Products, Power and Utilities and Life Science Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary Exposure to databases such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg etc. To qualify for the role, you must have A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting (CA) or Business with 3-4 years of related work experience Master s or PhD degree in Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, Actuarial Science or related quantitative discipline Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in quantitative roles such as valuing complex securities such as Exotic Options, Structured Products etc. within global investment banks, asset management firms other financial services organizations. A minimum of 3 to 4 years direct experience in utilizing Valuation techniques and methodologies such as Purchase Price Allocations (PPA), Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Income Approach, market comparable, etc. in a business valuation firm or practice or in venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking, financial research, national valuation firm or experience working in a corporate finance role for an organization, preferably for M&A activities Experience in financial modelling including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred Preferable achievement in or significant progress towards a CFA, ASA, CPA or related certification Ideally, you ll also have Project management skills Strong communication and presentation skills What we look for A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment An opportunity to be a part of a market-prominent, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide. Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries What we offer EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success, as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Role Overview We re looking for an AI Video Editor to build and scale our AI-powered video production pipeline across Finance With Sharan and The 1% Club. From AI avatar explainers and AI-generated films to high-volume ad variations, you ll combine strong editing fundamentals with AI tools to create engaging content at scale. The role goes beyond editing individual videos. You ll build reusable workflows, experiment with emerging tools and automation, and help create a repeatable system for producing high-quality video content. Key Responsibilities Create AI avatar videos using approved scripts, with realistic voice, natural lip-sync and high-quality output. Generate AI films, scenes and B-roll while maintaining character, wardrobe and visual consistency. Create multiple hook variations and short-form ad edits for performance marketing campaigns. Build reusable prompts, templates, presets and automated workflows to improve production speed and consistency. Edit and finish videos with strong pacing, sound design, captions, transitions and storytelling. Review every output for visual artefacts, audio issues, caption accuracy, factual accuracy and overall quality. Stay updated on emerging AI video tools and recommend improvements to the production workflow. Who You Are An editor first, with strong short-form storytelling, pacing, sound design and captioning skills. Experienced in short-form video editing, with at least 6 months of hands-on experience using AI video tools. Able to demonstrate AI-generated videos that have been published, along with a portfolio of conventional edits. Skilled at directing AI tools through effective prompting, troubleshooting generation issues and maintaining visual consistency. Comfortable experimenting with AI avatars, video generation, voice tools and editing software such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects. Proactive about building efficient workflows and exploring automation tools; scripting and API experience are an added advantage. Detail-oriented, reliable and accountable, with a strong focus on quality, feedback and deadlines. Careful about consent, confidentiality, originality and compliance when creating financial content. Tools & Experience Experience with tools such as HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Flux, ComfyUI, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is valuable. You don t need to know every tool, but you should have hands-on expertise in relevant tools and the ability to learn new ones quickly. Bonus Points Experience creating content for finance, business or education creators. Experience running an AI-led or faceless content channel. Understanding of performance marketing metrics such as hook rate and hold rate. Experience building custom avatars, consistent AI characters or LoRAs. Strong scripting instincts and the ability to improve hooks and content structure. Important Note Accuracy, consent and compliance are essential. All financial claims must follow approved scripts, AI-generated likenesses require explicit consent, and content must meet applicable disclosure and compliance requirements. title: Payments Business Systems Analyst
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Business Analyst with around 5 years of experience to join our IT services team. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to analyze data, generate insights, and support data-driven decision-making for global clients. The role requires strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with SQL and BI tools, and the ability to translate business requirements into meaningful reports. Your future duties and responsibilities Required to understand new business requirements, conduct business analysis. Prepare data mapping, technical requirements and perform testing of applications. Analyze payment transactional data and provide recommendations to ensure no business/technical data leakage across the systems in the bank. Develop in depth knowledge of applications and their interdependences; understand the architecture, payment flows, and optimal configurations of business solutions. Analyze and manipulate large data sets. Continually seek out process improvement opportunities and have full awareness of process controls. Demonstrate leadership and partnership skills by interacting with other business and technology teams within organization to solve problems and deliver solutions. Understand, document and interpret complex user requirements. The Business Systems Analyst will take a leadership role in working with and liaising with business partners, other Technology teams and external vendors to define the business and technical requirements at the program level. Review, analyze and evaluate detailed business and functional requirements, documentation, process flows and data models to contribute to the development of project plans including project charter, project deliverables, timeline estimates, scope and control. Develop use cases, define and document user procedures and workflows, and how each class of user interacts with east system function. title: Specialist - Commercial Standards Claims & Contract
description:
Job Summary Specialist - Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts is a Business Analyst and SME on the Customer Operations Transformation programme. The outcome is a clear, governed set of commercial policies - credit, claims, pricing and trade terms - and customer agreements that are standard, compliant and correctly executed in the systems; fewer and cleaner customer claims; lower invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage; and The scope spans Commercial Standards, Claims and Contracts end to end - formulation and governance of credit, claims, pricing and trade-terms policies, policy exceptions and delegation of authority, the customer agreement and contract lifecycle (drafting, approval, activation, amendment and renewal), pricing, rebate, discount and promotion setup, accruals, claims intake, validation and settlement, proof of performance, and the controls that link agreed terms to what is invoiced and paid. The role designs across this scope as one process rather than as separate contract, promotion and claims solutions. It works with market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service and Collections teams, GBO, D&T, the SAP and Control Tower (Claims and Deduction platform) teams and third-party vendors. Role capabilities Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies-the credit policy (credit limits, payment terms, risk categorisation, blocks and releases), the claims policy (eligibility, evidence, time limits, approval and write-off thresholds), and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount and rebate guardrails, price-change control) and the standards and controls that make them work in practice. As a business analyst, interrogate contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data, document current and target process, and write requirements to standard. As a subject matter expert, bring the functional depth to act as design authority for the fragment and to challenge solutions that would not work in the markets. As a sprint or project owner, take a scope fragment through design, test and deployment on a two to four week value drop cadence. As a process and technology expert, translate commercial policy, contract terms and controls into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction capability, and the contract and trade promotion management toolset. Key design disciplines The defining discipline of this role is designing claims out at source, not processing them faster. A quicker claim approval is a smaller prize than a contract term clear enough never to be disputed; a faster settlement is a smaller prize than a promotion set up correctly in the system so the customer never needs to claim. The postholder is expected to use the data to find where in the commercial process claims are created - an ambiguous contract clause, a non-standard trade term, a late or incorrect pricing or promotion setup, an accrual gap, a weak approval control - and design the fix upstream into commercial policy, standards, contract templates, deal approval and master data, as well as into the claims and settlement design. Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role. A claim usually starts life as a commercial negotiation; a contract term becomes a pricing condition, an accrual, an invoice and, if anything is misaligned, a deduction in Collections. The postholder is expected to know what happens on either side of their own process - from deal negotiation through to cash and the P&L - and to design accordingly. This is a transformation design and delivery role, not an operational one. The postholder does not negotiate customer deals, draft or approve individual contracts, validate or settle individual claims, or manage customer relationships; that stays with market Commercial, Legal, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done - including the commercial policies, standards, contract templates, reason codes, analytics and controls that let run teams find and remove causes in BAU. The role formulates and recommends policy; final approval sits with the relevant policy owners and governance forums. Working style and governance The role works independently within an agreed frame set by the workstream lead, gathers its own data, forms its own view and brings recommendations rather than questions. Where a Senior Specialist is assigned on the same fragment, it works under their design direction. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS. Baseline and design / Analysis Analyse commercial terms, contracts and claims performance and baseline the problem - 25%. Document current-state credit, claims and pricing policies, commercial standards, contract lifecycle and claims processes across markets and identify variation from the global standard. Build the process, trade-terms and claim-type taxonomy and interrogate the data directly at portfolio level - customer agreements and terms, pricing and promotion conditions, accruals versus actuals, claims volume, value, ageing and rejection rates, invalid deductions, write-offs and trade-spend leakage - to baseline the problem per market and size the opportunity. Perform gap analysis between current process, commercial policy, contract terms, platform capability, controls and the target operating model, separating structural design issues from operational backlog. Support business-rule validation, master-data requirements and policy analysis. Aim for validated current-state documentation and a defensible baseline that will stand up to audit. Formulate commercial policies and standards, and design claims out at source - 25%. Support future-state design aligned to the global standard, always designing for the cause rather than the symptom. Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies the design depends on - credit policy (credit limits and risk categorisation, payment terms, credit blocks and release authority), claims policy (claim eligibility, evidence and proof-of-performance requirements, submission time limits, validation, approval and write-off thresholds) and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount, rebate and promotion guardrails, price-change control and margin protection) - with a clear policy-exception and delegation-of-authority framework, and take them through the governance forums for approval. Translate policy into the standards that operationalise it: standard trade-terms structures, contract and agreement templates

description:
External job description This is a contract role for 6 months
 The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employees situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified. 
 The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards. 
 Key job responsibilities 
 • Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees. 
 • Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues. 
 • Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon. 
 • Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employees changing needs. 
 • Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases. 
 • Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise. 
 • Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event. 
 • Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited. 
 • Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests. 
 • Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace. 
 • Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work. 
 • Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing. 
 • Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy. 
 • Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation. 
 • Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate. 
 Basic qualifications Bachelor's degree Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role Preferred qualifications 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field Experience identifying and resolving complex issues Experience handling confidential information Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

title: Order Processing Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 ORDER PROCESSING EXECUTIVE 
 Experience Required: 23 Years in Order Processing / IT Hardware Industry 
 Location: Bangalore 
 Job Type: Full-time 
 An order processing executive manages incoming customer purchases from entry to final 
 shipment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Order Entry and Verification: Receive and input purchase details, prices, and customer 
 information accurately into the company's software. 
 Inventory Coordination: Check stock levels to confirm product availability before fulfilling 
 requests. 
 Shipping and Logistics: Work with the warehouse team to ensure goods are picked, packed, 
 and labeled correctly for on-time delivery. 
 Customer Support: Answer buyer questions regarding delivery times, tracking, and order 
 status. 
 Issue Resolution: Handle returns, order cancellations, and payment discrepancies quickly. 
 1.Receiving Inventory 
 Unload incoming goods from suppliers or manufacturers. 
 Inspect items for damage and verify quantities match the purchase order. 
 Log the items into the inventory management system. 
 2.Storing Inventory 
 Move goods to short- or long-term storage in the warehouse. 
 Organize products logicallyoften placing fast-moving items in easily accessible locations 
 Label products with barcodes or tags for fast tracking. 
 3.Processing Orders 
 Begin when a customer places an order online or in-store. 
 Verify payment confirmation and check real-time stock availability. 
 Generate a digital packing slip for the warehouse. 
 www.tecqnio.com 
 
 
 
 4. Picking 
 Workers or warehouse robots use the packing slip to locate items. 
 Retrieve the correct sizes, colors, and quantities from shelves. 
 Use barcode scanners to reduce human error. 
 5. Packing 
 Select appropriate boxes, mailers, and padding (like bubble wrap) to protect goods. 
 Keep package weight and size as low as possible to reduce shipping costs. 
 Seal the box and apply the shipping label. 
 6. Shipping 
 Hand off the packed boxes to a logistics carrier (like a postal service or freight line). 
 Provide tracking information to the customer. 
 Dispatch the shipment on a transport vehicle. 
 7. Processing Returns 
 Handle items sent back by customers due to size, defects, or preference. 
 Inspect returned goods to see if they can be restocked. 
 Issue refunds or exchanges and update inventory logs.

title: Strategy & Planning Manager
description:
Job Summary Meet the Team. Join Cisco's Global Supply Chain Strategy & Planning team, an internal consulting organization focused on solving the most complex, cross-functional supply chain challenges that span multiple functions. The team takes ambiguous business problems from problem framing through analysis, recommendation, and leadership decision-making. Recent engagements have included designing operating models for new fulfillment capabilities, benchmarking Cisco against competitors, and building analytical business cases for significant inventory and sourcing decisions. Responsibilities As a Strategy & Planning Manager, you will own a workstream within a larger strategic engagement and work closely with the Engagement Lead. You will be accountable for structuring the problem, leading the analysis, engaging stakeholders, and developing a clear recommendation that leadership can act on. You will combine quantitative analysis, business judgment, external benchmarking, and stakeholder management to develop a point of view, clearly articulate trade-offs, and influence senior leaders toward informed decisions. You will own a workstream end-to-end, from problem definition and structuring through analysis and final recommendation. You will build the quantitative analysis that underpins strategic decisions, including financial models, scenarios, business cases, and analytical frameworks, using clearly defined assumptions where data is incomplete. You will independently manage stakeholder relationships across Business Units, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Channel, and Finance, bringing together conflicting inputs and driving alignment without unnecessary escalation. You will conduct external benchmarking and competitive analysis where relevant, translating findings into clear implications and recommendations for Cisco. You will develop and defend a clear point of view, articulate key trade-offs, and confidently respond to challenge from senior stakeholders. You will present your workstream findings to senior leaders and contribute to the broader engagement storyline and recommendation. You will guide analysts supporting your workstream by reviewing their analysis, strengthening problem structuring, and developing their communication and presentation skills. You will collaborate with Business Units, Supply Chain Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Channel, Finance, and senior business stakeholders across Cisco. You will also work closely with the broader Strategy & Planning team and Engagement Leads on cross-functional strategic engagements. You are a structured, analytical, and commercially minded problem solver who is comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information. You can quickly break down open-ended problems, determine the key questions that need to be answered, build a fact base, and turn analysis into a clear recommendation. You are confident working directly with senior stakeholders, can navigate conflicting perspectives, and are comfortable defending your point of view with data and business logic. You communicate top-down and answer-first, ensuring that your recommendations are clear, concise, and actionable. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or supply chain operations. Proven experience owning workstreams from problem definition through completion. Demonstrated ability to structure open-ended and loosely defined business problems into an actionable analytical framework. Strong ability to build quantitative models from incomplete data using clearly stated assumptions. Experience independently managing relationships with senior stakeholders. Strong ability to communicate top-down and lead with the answer rather than the analysis. Demonstrated ability to form, communicate, and defend a recommendation under challenge. Preferred Qualifications Experience in operations or supply chain consulting, particularly in operating model design, inventory, network design, or process improvement. Experience mentoring, coaching, or reviewing the work of junior analysts. Experience with analytical tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau. Experience working across global teams, geographies, and time zones.

description:
About us: As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of Americas leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and youll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. Overview about TII At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company s global strategy and operations. 
 Target Creative s Brand Design Lab (BDL) is the in-house creative team dedicated to building and bringing Target s owned brands to life. Working as one integrated team across the U.S. and India, BDL develops differentiated brand identities, packaging systems and creative expressions that connect strategy, design and storytelling across Target s portfolio. Some of the brands we have built include Good & Gather, up&up, Hearth & Hand, Cat & Jack, Kindfull and Goodfellow & Co. 
 About this Opportunity As a Sr. Manager, Associate Creative Director , you will play a key role in shaping how Target s owned brands show up through design. You will guide creative teams, establish a strong point of view and ensure our work is distinctive, relevant and unmistakably Target. Your impact will extend beyond individual projects. You will raise the standard of creative work, make thoughtful and confident creative decisions, grow talent and use design to influence broader brand and business outcomes. Working across Target s global organization, you will bring together strategy, creativity and craft to build meaningful brand experiences for our guests. What You ll Do Establish the creative vision and guide teams in building distinctive brand identities, packaging and design systems. Set a consistently high standard for creative thinking, design quality and craft across the work. Turn brand strategy, business priorities and guest insights into meaningful creative ideas and design solutions. Guide the work from early-stage thinking and concept development through design execution and production. Make confident creative decisions and give clear, timely and actionable feedback that moves the work forward. Build strong creative teams and actively coach, mentor and develop the next generation of creative leaders. Oversee multiple complex initiatives, creating focus and making thoughtful decisions across priorities, resources and timelines. Partner closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Packaging, Product Development and Project Management across global teams. Build alignment and influence outcomes by clearly articulating creative thinking, rationale and recommendations. Stay connected to Target s business, guests, culture, categories and the broader design landscape to bring fresh thinking into the work. Look beyond individual assignments to identify opportunities to strengthen our brands, creative capabilities and ways of working. What You ll Bring 15+ years of experience across brand design, packaging and/or creative direction. A strong portfolio demonstrating depth of thinking and excellence across brand identity, packaging and design systems. A highly evolved creative eye and strong judgment across brand, design and craft. Experience guiding multidisciplinary creative teams and delivering complex creative programs from idea through execution. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex creative thinking clear and compelling. The ability to see the bigger picture and connect creative choices to brand strategy, guest needs and business priorities. A track record of coaching and developing creative talent and helping others do their best work. Confidence working through ambiguity, setting direction and making decisions when there isn t an obvious answer. The ability to build credibility and strong relationships across disciplines, levels, cultures and global teams. Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, production processes and emerging tools and technologies. Curiosity, adaptability and a desire to continuously learn and evolve as a creative leader.
 What Success Looks Like You elevate the quality of the work and the thinking behind it. You create clarity and momentum for teams. You grow people and future leaders. You build trust across the organization and connect creative ambition to what matters for our guests and the business. Most importantly, you create an environment where strong ideas, great design and talented people can flourish.

This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Based in Bangalore, this position will lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists supporting sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer coordination, helping deliver consistent service and an outstanding experience for internal and external candidates. Develop and execute rollout plans covering process documentation, responsibilities, training, milestones, and adoption tracking; identify barriers and coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate leaders. Establish clear workflows and service expectations from requisition intake through sourcing, interview scheduling, offer coordination, and handoff to onboarding. Lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists through training, regular feedback, quality reviews, and hands-on support for complex or urgent needs. Help coordinate team priorities, monitor capacity and service delivery, and work with the appropriate leaders to address bottlenecks across regions and time zones. Ensure sourcing aligns with role requirements and agreed recruiting strategies, interview scheduling is responsive, and offer documentation and approvals are accurate and timely. Work collaboratively with senior leaders and hiring teams to understand hiring needs, share progress, and contribute practical ideas that support effective recruitment. Partner with recruiters, HRBPs, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners to clarify responsibilities, address questions, and support consistent follow-through. Provide a professional, respectful candidate experience through timely updates, clear interview instructions, reliable coordination, and appropriate communication when candidates are not selected. Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback and implement improvements to communication, scheduling, and offer processes that reflect Diversified s values and employer brand. Partner with HR Operations and technology teams to align ATS workflows, templates, approvals, and reporting with the global process; support consistent system use and accurate records. Analyze ATS utilization, open requisition aging, time to fill, time to hire, time in stage, sourcing effectiveness, candidate conversion, withdrawals, and offer acceptance. Prepare recurring dashboards and concise reporting that explain trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend actions, and track the impact of process improvements. Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR. Qualifications Education Education: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. Experience 8+ years of progressive talent acquisition or recruitment operations experience, including at least 3 years leading, guiding, and coaching a recruitment or talent acquisition support team. Global Implementation Experience: Demonstrated success implementing standardized recruitment processes across multiple countries or regions, including supporting US stakeholders from India or another global delivery location. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred. Skills and Competencies Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change. Industry Experience: Experience supporting technology, engineering, or project delivery recruitment preferred. Key Success Metrics Delivers agreed global rollout milestones and achieves consistent process adoption across participating regions. Strengthens specialist capability and improves responsiveness, accuracy, and completion of sourcing, scheduling, and offer coordination activities. Improves ATS utilization, data completeness, and timely updates to requisition and candidate records. Reduces avoidable delays, aged open requisitions, and time spent in hiring stages against agreed baselines and targets. Improves candidate and hiring manager feedback, candidate progression, and offer acceptance through better communication and coordination. Provides accurate, timely reporting and recommendations that result in measurable recruitment process improvements.

title: Physical Verification Engineer
description:
Design Rule Checking (DRC): Run DRC checks using industry-standard tools to identify violations of manufacturing design rules. Collaborate with layout designers to resolve DRC issues. Layout vs. Schematic (LVS) Verification: Perform LVS checks to ensure that the physical layout accurately matches the schematic and that there are no electrical connectivity discrepancies. Electrical Rule Checking (ERC): Verify that the layout adheres to electrical constraints and requirements, such as voltage and current limitations, ensuring that the IC functions as intended. Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Collaborate with design and manufacturing teams to optimize the layout for the semiconductor fabrication process. Address lithography and process variation concerns. Process Technology Calibration: Calibrate layout extraction tools and parameters to match the specific process technology used for fabrication. Resolution Enhancement Techniques (RET): Implement RET techniques to improve the printability of layout patterns during the photolithography process. Fill Insertion: Insert fill cells into the layout to improve planarity and reduce manufacturing-related issues, such as wafer warping and stress. Multi-Patterning and Advanced Nodes: Deal with challenges specific to advanced process nodes, including multi-patterning, coloring, and metal stack variations. Hotspot Analysis: Identify and address potential hotspot areas that may lead to manufacturing defects or yield issues. Post-Processing Simulation: Perform post-processing simulations to verify that the layout is compatible with the manufacturing process and does not introduce unwanted parasitics. Process Integration Checks: Collaborate with process integration teams to ensure the smooth integration of the design with the semiconductor fabrication process. Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of verification processes, methodologies, and results.

 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model.
