In this role, you will assist customers with their queries, provide appropriate solutions, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through effective communication and timely support. About Us NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is India's first PropTech unicorn. It is a brokerage-free real estate platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for intermediaries. With a strong customer base across major Indian cities, NoBroker is transforming the real estate industry through technology-driven solutions and customer-focused services. Query Resolution: Understand customer issues and provide accurate, timely, and effective solutions. Service Excellence: Ensure a smooth customer experience while maintaining high service quality standards. Follow-ups: Contact customers when required to provide updates, resolve pending queries, and ensure customer satisfaction. Issue Escalation: Identify complex issues and escalate them to the appropriate team for resolution. Customer Feedback: Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the overall service experience. Performance Goals: Meet defined targets related to call quality, customer satisfaction, productivity, and resolution time. Documentation: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, queries, and resolutions in the company's systems. Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers Education: HSC (12th pass) or graduate candidates can apply. Communication Skills: Good verbal communication and active listening skills. Interpersonal Skills: Ability to handle customer queries professionally and maintain positive customer relationships. Technical Skills: Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office are preferred. Work Schedule: Comfortable working 6 days a week, with one weekday off. Shift Timing: Flexible to work a 9-hour shift scheduled between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM. Perks & Value Proposition Health Insurance: Company-paid health insurance coverage of 1 lakh per year. Career Growth: Opportunities for internal career progression based on performance. Promotions: Regular performance reviews, with promotions every six months and accelerated opportunities for outstanding performers, as per company policy. Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers. Team-Building Activities: Regular team events and an annual outing. Why NoBroker? At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to grow professionally while delivering exceptional customer experiences. Join a collaborative and fast-paced work environment where your communication skills, customer-focused approach, and problem-solving abilities can make a real difference. Apply today and take the next step in your career with NoBroker!

Tele Calling Executive 
 Department: Sales & Customer Servicing
 Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru
 Position Type: Full-time
 Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components and based on relevant experience) 
 About NoBroker 
 NoBroker.com is India's leading brokerage-free real estate platform, connecting property owners, buyers, and tenants directly without intermediaries. Founded in 2014, NoBroker has grown into a leading PropTech company with a strong presence across major Indian cities. Role Overview We are looking for Tele Calling Executives who can effectively communicate with customers, understand their requirements, provide relevant solutions, and contribute to sales and customer satisfaction. The role involves handling both inbound and outbound calls and may include customer servicing, relationship management, lead follow-ups, and sales conversion. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 34 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer interaction process. Understand customer requirements and provide suitable information, solutions, and assistance related to NoBroker's property and services. Build strong customer relationships through effective communication, regular follow-ups, and timely resolution of queries. For sales-related interactions, pitch relevant NoBroker services, negotiate effectively, and convert qualified leads into customers. For customer-service interactions, act as a relationship manager for customers and ensure a smooth and satisfactory service experience. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, leads, follow-ups, and conversions using internal CRM and calling tools. Adhere to company processes, quality standards, and customer-service guidelines. Work towards individual and team performance goals and contribute to overall business objectives. Ensure a positive customer experience through professional communication and effective problem-solving. 
 Perks & Benefits 
 Performance Incentives: Up to 20,00025,000 per month, depending on role and performance. Health Insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company. Career Growth: Opportunity to progress to Assistant Manager roles based on performance and experience. Promotions: Performance-based promotions, with regular performance reviews. Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition for high-performing employees. Team Engagement: Regular team activities, parties, and Annual Day celebrations. Employee Referral Program: Referral incentives for successful hires. 
 Eligibility & Skill Requirements 
 Education: 10th, 12th, or Graduate candidates can apply. Candidates should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course. Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant customer service, telecalling, sales, or relationship-management experience can apply. Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills . Customer-oriented approach with good listening and problem-solving abilities. For sales responsibilities, candidates should have good negotiation, persuasion, and target-oriented skills . Basic proficiency in MS Office, CRM, and calling tools . Languages: English is mandatory. Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi will be an added advantage. Candidates should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage . Candidates should be available for immediate joining . Age: 18 to 30 years. 
 Work Schedule 
 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days. One rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday. Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in emergencies. 
 Why Join NoBroker? Join a fast-growing PropTech company and gain experience across customer service, sales, relationship management, and real estate operations . The role offers performance-based incentives, structured career growth, employee recognition, and opportunities to take on greater responsibilities based on performance.

title: Workplace Experience Coordinator
description:
Job Summary 
 The Procurement Operations Executive will support end-to-end procurement for workplace events, employee engagement programs, leadership visits, and office requirements. The role focuses on requirement validation, vendor coordination, quotation analysis, Purchase Order (PO) tracking, invoice support, budget reporting, and procurement compliance in partnership with the Workplace Experience (WEP), Procurement, and Finance teams. 
 
 Job Details 
 Job Location: Gurugram Designation: Workplace Experience Coordinator Educational Qualification: Graduate degree required, preferably in Commerce Experience Required: 2-5 years of experience Shift Timings: General Shift 8AM to 5PM, 9AM to 6PM, 10AM-7PM, 12PM to 9PM Work Schedule: 6 Days/week Specific Skills: Proficient in data analysis with core competencies in vendor management, price comparison analysis, numerical and data analytics, procurement pricing, and creating comparison spreadsheets. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 Manage procurement requirements for workplace events, engagement programs, leadership visits, and office initiatives. Collect clear specifications, quantities, timelines, and budgets from internal stakeholders. Coordinate with approved vendors to obtain competitive quotations within defined timelines. Prepare commercial comparison statements and support vendor selection based on cost, quality, service, and compliance. Raise and track purchase requisitions and coordinate PO creation, approval, amendment, utilization, and closure. Validate quotations, POs, Statements of Work (SOWs), invoices, and supporting documents against approved scope and budget. Monitor event and operational spend, identify variances, and maintain accurate budget-utilization trackers. Coordinate vendor onboarding and ensure required due-diligence and compliance documents are complete. Follow up with vendors and internal teams for timely delivery, invoice submission, and payment processing. Maintain procurement records, approvals, quotations, POs, invoices, and closure documents for audit readiness. Prepare periodic MIS reports covering PO status, spend, savings, procurement turnaround time, and pending actions. Support cost optimization, vendor benchmarking, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives. Escalate procurement delays, documentation gaps, budget deviations, or policy non-compliance to the relevant stakeholders. Worked as back-up for WEP Ambassador for all day to day events and support. 
 
 Key Deliverables 
 Quotation and commercial comparison tracker Purchase requisition and PO status tracker Budget utilization and variance report Procurement savings and cost benchmark report Vendor onboarding and compliance tracker Invoice and payment follow-up tracker Vendor performance scorecard Monthly procurement MIS and leadership dashboard Complete procurement documentation and audit-ready repository 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Facility Management, or related field. 2 to 5 years of experience in procurement operations, workplace services, facilities, or event procurement. Experience in quotation analysis, vendor coordination, PO management, invoice processing, and budget tracking. Good working knowledge of procurement policies, approval of workflows, commercial terms, and financial processes. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel trackers, MIS reports, cost comparisons, and data analysis; knowledge of Power BI is an advantage. Exposure to SAP, ServiceNow, or similar procurement/ERP systems is preferred. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, stakeholder management, and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple requirements, meet timelines, and work independently with attention to detail. 
 
 Key Competencies 
 Procurement and commercial analysis Vendor and stakeholder coordination PO, invoice, and budget management MIS reporting and Excel proficiency Compliance and documentation control Cost optimization and problem-solving 
 
 Location 
 On-site Bengaluru; Gurugram 
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours 
 48

title: Principal Engineer - AI Engineering
description:
Job Description Summary GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Prompt Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes. We are driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the businesss mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernovas businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy. Job Description Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts. Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs. Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications. Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units. Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness. Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection. Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base. Qualifications/Requirements: Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field with 16-19 years'' relevant experience . Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAIs GPT models, Hugging Face, etc. Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing project requirements. Candidate must be willing to travel a minimum of 2 weeks per year Ideal Candidate Characteristics: PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, or related field Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy). Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects. Familiarity with version control systems like Git. Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Senior Engineer NPI
description:
Job Title: Assistant Manager / Manager NPI Engineering Department: Manufacturing Engineering
 Reports To: Senior Manager / Head – Engineering / Operations
 Experience: 8 - 10 Years
 Industry: Electronics Manufacturing / EMS Job Summary The Assistant Manager / Manager – NPI Engineering will be responsible for leading and managing the New Product Introduction (NPI) function, driving the successful transition of new electronic products from design and development into stable, scalable, and cost-effective mass production. The role will lead NPI activities across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, procurement, and customer teams, ensuring product and process readiness within defined timelines, quality standards, and cost targets. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing, PCBA, SMT, through-hole assembly, box build, process engineering, DFM/DFT, and NPI execution, along with demonstrated experience in managing cross-functional teams and customer-facing NPI projects. Key Responsibilities 1. NPI Leadership & Project Management Lead and manage end-to-end NPI activities from project kick-off through pilot builds, validation, ramp-up, and mass production. Establish NPI project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements. Drive multiple NPI projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to quality, cost, delivery, and engineering requirements. Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for customers during the NPI execution phase , coordinating technical discussions, project updates, risks, and action plans. Review customer engineering data, drawings, BOMs, Gerber files, CAD data, specifications, and assembly requirements. Identify technical, manufacturing, material, and capacity risks at an early stage and drive mitigation plans. Conduct regular NPI project reviews with internal and external stakeholders. 2. Product & Process Engineering Lead DFM/DFT reviews and provide manufacturing inputs during the product development stage. Ensure products are designed for efficient manufacturing, assembly, inspection, and testing. Define and establish optimized manufacturing processes for SMT, through-hole, PCBA, cable assembly, box build, and final assembly. Develop process flow, work instructions, process parameters, inspection criteria, and manufacturing documentation. Lead process validation and ensure process capability and stability prior to mass production. Support development of tooling, fixtures, stencils, test fixtures, jigs, and other manufacturing aids. 3. Production Readiness & NPI Launch Drive complete manufacturing readiness for prototype, EVT/DVT/PVT, pilot, and mass-production builds, as applicable. Lead First Article / pilot production builds and ensure timely closure of all build-related issues. Analyze defects, yield losses, process deviations, and manufacturing issues during early builds. Coordinate with Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth production ramp-up. Establish production readiness checklists and ensure closure of all open actions before mass production release. Monitor NPI performance against agreed KPIs such as yield, cycle time, cost, quality, and launch timelines. 4. BOM, Engineering Data & Change Management Review and validate BOMs for completeness, accuracy, manufacturability, and ERP/MRP alignment. Ensure correct material structures, alternates, component specifications, and assembly requirements are established. Lead implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), product revisions, and process changes. Ensure engineering and manufacturing documentation is controlled and released through the appropriate PLM/ERP systems. Coordinate with customers and internal engineering teams on drawing, BOM, specification, and revision-related changes. 5. Customer & Cross-Functional Management Establish strong technical and professional relationships with customers during NPI and product transfer activities. Lead technical discussions related to manufacturability, process capability, quality, tooling, testing, and production readiness. title: Senior Manager
description:
Job Description Senior Manager Global Regulatory Affairs to lead regulatory activities for peptide and complex generic products across the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, and Emerging Markets. The role will be responsible for developing and executing global regulatory strategies, leading dossier submissions and health authority responses, supporting scientific advice and pre-submission interactions, and managing the regulatory lifecycle of products across multiple markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in CTD/eCTD submissions, ANDAs, EU/UK regulatory procedures, global registrations, regulatory strategy, CMC documentation, health authority interactions, and post-approval lifecycle management. Experience with peptide products, complex injectables, or other complex generic products is highly desirable. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Global Regulatory Strategy & Submissions • Develop and execute regulatory strategies for peptide and complex generic products across the US, EU, UK, and Emerging Markets. • Lead review and submission of regulatory dossiers in CTD, eCTD, ACTD, and country-specific formats, as applicable. • Drive regulatory planning from development through submission, approval, launch readiness, and post-approval lifecycle management. • Assess country-specific regulatory requirements, submission pathways, documentation gaps, and potential regulatory risks. • Ensure high-quality and timely submissions in accordance with applicable health authority requirements and committed project timelines . 2. Cross-Functional Regulatory Leadership • Coordinate closely with R&D/Formulation Development, Analytical Development, QA, QC, Manufacturing, Clinical/BE, Supply Chain, Program Management, Commercial, and other stakeholders to obtain regulatory submission documentation. Review documents received from cross-functional teams for adequacy, completeness, scientific consistency, and regulatory compliance before incorporation into regulatory dossiers. • Provide regulatory guidance to development and CMC teams to ensure that development programs and supporting documentation are aligned with target market requirements. • Identify potential regulatory gaps and risks early and facilitate appropriate mitigation plans with relevant stakeholders. 3. Health Authority Queries & Regulatory Interactions • Develop strategies for effective and timely responses to health authority deficiencies, information requests, and regulatory queries. • Review and approve responses prepared by cross-functional teams to ensure scientific accuracy, consistency with the submitted dossier, and regulatory compliance. • Coordinate multidisciplinary response teams and facilitate closure of agency queries within regulatory timelines. • Support review, and coordination of FDA Pre-ANDA meetings, Scientific Advice meetings, and other health authority interactions, as applicable. 4. Product Lifecycle Management • Lead regulatory activities associated with renewals, variations, supplements, amendments, annual reporting, and other post-approval changes across global markets. • Review and approve change controls and assess regulatory impact across affected markets. • Determine appropriate implementation and submission strategies for post approval changes in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. • Review regulatory approval packages and communicate approval conditions, commitments, and implementation requirements to cross-functional teams. 5. US Regulatory Activities • Provide regulatory oversight for ANDA submissions and post-approval regulatory activities for the US market. • Coordinate regulatory fee-related activities, including GDUFA cover sheets for ANDA-related fees, facility fees, and program fees, where applicable. • Support coordination of regulatory agency, consultant, and partner-related payments. • Contribute to regulatory strategy and documentation for Pre-ANDA interactions and other FDA engagements. 6. EU & UK Regulatory Activities • Support and manage applicable EU and UK submission procedures, including national and multi-country regulatory activities. • Coordinate national-phase submission activities following European procedures, including collaboration with local regulatory consultants and translation vendors. • Oversee documentation required for renewals, variations, post-approval commitments, and lifecycle management activities. • Facilitate implementation of approvals across relevant EU/UK markets. 7. Emerging-Market Registrations • Lead dossier preparation and country-specific submission activities for Emerging Markets in accordance with applicable CTD, ACTD, or national requirements. • Coordinate country-specific documentation, samples, legalization, translations, certificates, and other registration requirements, as applicable. • Ensure timely submission of registration samples required by health authorities. • Coordinate with local regulatory representatives, partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders to support submission and approval activities. 8. Regulatory Compliance & Systems • Ensure timely and accurate updates to Regulatory Information Management Systems (RIMS), including submission records, deficiency tracking, approval information, document archives, and dossier trackers. • Maintain appropriate regulatory records and ensure traceability of submissions, correspondence, commitments, and approvals. • Review documentation supporting GMP applications and manufacturing/site related regulatory submissions, as applicable. • Ensure regulatory commitments and agency requirements are appropriately tracked through closure. 
 Qualification & Experience • M.Pharm / M.Sc. / Pharm.D. / Ph.D. or equivalent qualification in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. • Approximately 12-15 years of experience in pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs, preferably encompassing global markets. • Strong hands-on experience with submissions and lifecycle management for the US, EU, UK, and Emerging Markets. • Experience with peptide products, complex generics, injectable products, or technically complex drug products is strongly preferred. • Good understanding of CMC regulatory requirements, CTD/eCTD dossier structure, ANDA requirements, EU/UK regulatory procedures, and post-approval change management. • Experience in managing regulatory authority queries and multidisciplinary response teams. • Experience with FDA Pre-ANDA meetings, Scientific Advice, or other health authority interactions would be an advantage. Key Competencies • Strong global regulatory strategy and regulatory science orientation. • Sound understanding of peptide and complex generic product development challenges. • Excellent dossier review and technical writing capabilities. • Strong analytical and regulatory problem-solving skills. • Ability to interpret evolving regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable development or submission strategies. • Proven capability to manage multiple products, markets, submissions, and competing timelines. • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management and influencing skills. • Ability to independently drive complex regulatory assignments and escalate critical risks appropriately. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

title: Sr Sourcing Manager, Process & Systems Excellence
description:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Overview: The Senior Manager, Process & Systems Excellence is responsible for driving the continuous improvement of Global Sourcing's Source-to-Pay processes, systems and technology landscape. Working as the technical-functional and operational deputy to the Director, Process & Systems Excellence, the role leads process design, workflow optimisation, business analysis, requirements management, testing and implementation activities across platforms including ZIP, SAP Ariba and related sourcing technologies. 
 The position supports engagement with Finance Systems Strategy (FSS) and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable solutions that improve efficiency, user experience, compliance and operational performance. The role combines procurement expertise, systems knowledge and continuous improvement practices to identify opportunities for simplification, automation and technology-enabled transformation across Global Sourcing's global operating model. 
 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, Technology, Information Systems or Business. Significant experience in procurement, sourcing operations, business analysis, process excellence, procurement technology or Source-to-Pay transformation. Strong understanding of Source-to-Pay processes and procurement operating models. Hands-on experience with SAP Ariba and strong familiarity with procurement workflow, sourcing or intake platforms such as ZIP. Experience supporting senior leaders in partnerships with FSS, Product, Technology, Engineering or Systems teams. Experience reviewing and redesigning business processes to improve operational outcomes. Strong business analysis and requirements-gathering skills. Experience developing future-state process and system designs. Experience managing or supporting UAT, implementation and change activities. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Excellent stakeholder-management and communication skills. Proven ability to influence and deliver within a complex global matrix. Demonstrated ability to drive technology-enabled transformation and operational improvement. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 Interview Venue: Bangalore :: E-City Phase 2:: Infosys Limited, No. 40/P-41/P, Gate#: 1, Electronic City Phase-2, Industrial Area, Konappana Agrahara, Bangalore- 560100. Landmark : In Between Sunik Industries and Tejas Networks. 
 Please find below Job Description for your reference: Job Location: Bengaluru Qualification: Any Graduate (Full Time) Experience: 1- 4 Years Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 15 days Shift: Flexible to work with any shift (Including Night Shifts) Work Mode: 5 Days Work from Office Job Level: 2A/ 3A Designation: Senior Process Executive/ Process Specialist 
 Note: Only candidates with international experience are eligible for consideration. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A: 
 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle: Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb). Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs. Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments. Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates. 
 B. Evidence & Documentation: Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts. Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready. 
 C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly. Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications). 
 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics. 
 E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health. Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions. 
 Required Qualifications: 1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration). Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools. Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case. High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote). 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight. Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices. Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus. Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention. Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A: 
 Role Summary: Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Complex Case Leadership: Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code. Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts. 
 B. Rule Interpretation & Governance: Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations. Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations. 
 C. Quality & Enablement: Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects. Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements. 
 D. Prevention & Analytics: Identify friendly-fraud patterns and systemic gaps; recommend prevention (descriptor hygiene, refund/return design, SCA/3DS). Collaborate with Analytics/Automation to scale insights and reduce manual workload. 
 Required Qualifications: Deep knowledge of VCR/MDR, Amex & Discover procedures; strong case-law style writing. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom, Amex/Discover portals; CRM; intermediate Excel; SQL/BI preferred. Proven track record improving win rates and reducing pre-arb volumes. 
 Documents to Carry: Carry a printout your updated resume. Carry any 2 photo Identity proof (PAN Card/Driving License/Voters ID card/Passport). All original education documents needs to be available for verification. (10th, 12th, Graduation (Sem Wise Marksheet, CMM. Provisional and Original Degree) 
 Mandatory to carry: Smartphone with good front camera, charger and Headset for Assessment, Government ID proof Hardcopy.

Practical experience with JumpCloud MDM and endpoint device management. Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, networking, and mobile device support. Familiarity with remote desktop tools and help desk/ticketing systems. Knowledge of ISO 27001 standards is an added advantage. title: Vulnerability Management Analyst - Qualys Power User
description:
Vulnerability Management Analyst - Qualys Power User Location: Any Genpact Location Experience: 5-15 years Immediate joiners preferred MST Shift 
 Job Description : The Senior Security Analyst (TVM Operations) ensures the organization maintains a comprehensive and real-time view of its security posture. This operational role manages the daily execution of the Qualys platform, utilizing VMDR, CSAM, and EASM to detect vulnerabilities, discover unmanaged assets, and monitor our external attack surface. You will not be patching systems yourself; rather, you will be the "source of truth" for partner teams. Your goal is to deliver accurate, actionable data into Jira, collaborate with System Administrators to prioritize fixes, and validate that remediation has occurred. Operational Specialist: You enjoy the rhythm of daily operationsensuring scans run, agents report, and data flows correctly. The "Radar Operator": You are vigilant about the External Attack Surface (EASM), spotting exposed services or forgotten subdomains before adversaries do. Collaborative Influencer: Since you do not apply the patches, you rely on building strong relationships with IT partner teams to drive remediation action. Data Steward: You understand that a Vulnerability Management program is only as good as its asset inventory (CSAM), and you relentlessly chase down "unknown" assets. Ticket Master: You are comfortable working in Jira, ensuring that security findings don't get lost in the backlog. • Qualys Operations: Manage the daily health of the Qualys subscription, specifically VMDR (Vulnerability Management), CSAM (CyberSecurity Asset Management), and EASM (External Attack Surface Management). Asset Discovery & Hygiene (CSAM): continuously monitor the network for unmanaged devices and unauthorized software. Work with IT to install agents or decommission shadow IT. External Exposure (EASM): Monitor the organization’s external footprint. Identify and alert on unexpected public-facing assets, open ports, or expired certificates. Vulnerability Remediation Management: Translate scan findings into actionable Jira tickets. Assign tasks to appropriate partner teams (Server, Network, Cloud) and participate in sprint planning/backlog reviews to advocate for security tasks. Remediation Verification: Execute validation scans (re-scans) once partner teams mark Jira tickets as "Resolved" to confirm the vulnerability is truly closed. Scanning Execution: Configure and schedule discovery and vulnerability scans. Manage scanner appliances and exclude lists to prevent operational disruption. False Positive Analysis: Review technical evidence provided by partner teams to validate "False Positive" or "Risk Acceptance" requests. Reporting & Metrics: Generate weekly operational reports on "Open Vulnerabilities vs. Closed," Remediation SLAs, and Agent Health. Agent Health: Troubleshoot Qualys Cloud Agents on endpoints that have stopped reporting or are failing to authenticate. Threat Triage: When high-profile vulnerabilities (e.g., Log4j, HTTP/2 Rapid Reset) are announced, use VMDR and CSAM to provide immediate impact assessments to leadership. Bachelor’s degree in information security, computer science, or equivalent operational experience. Qualys Power User: Proven operational experience with VMDR (running scans, analyzing results). Asset Management Experience: Experience using Qualys CSAM or similar tools to reconcile asset inventories and identify "blind spots" in coverage. Attack Surface Knowledge: Experience with EASM concepts—understanding DNS, public IP ranges, and how to identify assets that shouldn't be on the internet. Jira Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Jira for ticket management. Ability to use JQL (Jira Query Language) to search for issues and create dashboards. Partner Collaboration: A track record of successfully working with System Administrators and DevOps teams. You know how to "speak their language" to get patches prioritized. Network & OS Fundamentals: Sufficient knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Networking to help partner teams understand where a vulnerability is located and why it needs fixing. Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose why a scanner can't reach a host or why an agent is offline. Analytical Mindset: Ability to correlate an external finding (EASM) with an internal vulnerability (VMDR) to determine true risk. Qualys Power User Cloud Security Analyst level understanding Interpersonal skills to be able to form relationships with partner teams Familiarity with Jira/Confluence Analytical mindset and SIEM experience a bonus

Key Skills: Cloud Security,IAM,Vulnerability Management,JIRA,Qualys,SOC,SIEM,Cloud

title: Workplace Investigator - MEA / APAC / NA
description:
The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, Integrity is an independent and objective organization that forms an integral part of the Legal Integrity Function. We are expanding our team to strengthen our focus on workplace-related investigations. The team is responsible for receiving and managing allegations involving employee misconduct and violations of the Code of Conduct, overseeing the full investigation lifecycle, and supporting appropriate disciplinary and remediation actions. As a Senior Investigator - Workplace Related Matters, you will play a critical role in conducting complex, multi-jurisdictional workplace investigations that may impact employees, business operations, and the company''s reputation. Working closely with Legal, Integrity, HR, and other stakeholders, you will lead investigations from intake through closure while fostering a culture of integrity and accountability across the organization. How You''ll Make an Impact Conduct workplace-related investigations under the direction of the Head of OSI - Labor/Workplace Related Matters, independently or in collaboration with other Special Investigations Officers, Legal Integrity, and HR teams. Manage end-to-end investigative processes, including allegation assessment, evidence gathering, data collection, forensic analysis, witness interviews, documentation, and case closure. title: Inventory Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an Executive Inventory to manage day-to-day inventory operations at the warehouse. The role will be responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, monitoring stock movement, conducting physical stock counts, resolving inventory discrepancies, and ensuring smooth coordination between warehouse, operations, and supply chain teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage and monitor day-to-day inventory operations at the warehouse. Maintain accurate records of inward, outward, transfer, and return inventory . Ensure proper GRN, stock transfer, picking, put-away, and dispatch processes. Conduct regular physical stock counts / cycle counts and reconcile the same with system inventory. Identify and investigate stock discrepancies, shortages, excess stock, damages, and mismatches . Ensure proper SKU-wise inventory tracking and storage . Monitor inventory ageing, slow-moving, non-moving, and damaged stock . Coordinate with Warehouse, Operations, SCM, and Finance teams for inventory-related issues. Maintain and update daily inventory reports, MIS, and stock reconciliation reports . Ensure proper FIFO / FEFO practices wherever applicable. Support monthly stock audits and inventory reconciliation . Ensure proper documentation and system updates for all inventory movements. Monitor RTO / returns inventory and ensure timely reconciliation and disposition. Support warehouse teams in maintaining proper bin locations and inventory organization . Identify process gaps and suggest improvements to improve inventory accuracy and operational efficiency . Ensure compliance with defined SOPs, inventory controls, and warehouse processes . 
 Required Skills 
 Strong knowledge of Inventory Management and Warehouse Operations . Good understanding of stock reconciliation and cycle counting . Strong MS Excel skills – VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/SUMIFS, basic MIS. Experience working on WMS / ERP / Inventory Management systems . Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced warehouse environment. Good attention to detail and accuracy. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates from E-commerce, D2C, FMCG, Retail, 3PL, Quick Commerce, or Warehouse Operations will be preferred.

title: Student Relationship Manager
description:
Job Title: Student Relationship Manager 
 Entry-Level | Individual Contributor | Campus-Based 
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Student Relationship Manager to be the single, non-academic point of contact for a mapped cohort of around 180 students on campus. This is an entry-level, high-visibility role for someone calm under pressure who genuinely enjoys helping people and owns a problem until it's actually closed not just logged. You'll be the first person students turn to for anything outside the classroom: hostel, mess, transport, fees, documentation, campus facilities, or simply needing to be heard. 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 0–1 years of experience — freshers are encouraged to apply Any graduate (bachelor's degree), any academic stream Excellent verbal and written communication skills Natural empathy and active listening — able to hear someone out fully without rushing to judgment or a canned response Calm and steady under pressure Proactive and self-starting — follows up and closes loops without needing to be chased Comfortable with basic tracker/spreadsheet discipline and a weekly reporting rhythm Willing to be based on campus full-time and work the academic calendar — this is not a remote or hybrid role 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a people-facing or service role — even part-time, an internship, or volunteering Familiarity with student life, hostels, or a residential campus environment 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Be the single point of contact every mapped student knows to go to for any non-academic issue Log, categorize, and route issues to the right owner (facilities, warden, finance, transport) with an SLA, and track to closure Run a standing cadence of check-ins to catch disengagement, attendance drops, or dissatisfaction early Own the NPS of the mapped cohort — run the feedback loop and act on what's driving detractor scores Liaise with campus administration and facility vendors on recurring issues Maintain a live issue tracker and share a weekly dashboard with Program Ops 
 Ideal Backgrounds Psychology, social work, HR, or hospitality management graduates; BPO/voice and chat customer service freshers; hospitality and aviation entry-role candidates (front office, guest relations, cabin crew trainees); campus placement candidates with strong extracurricular signals (NSS, student council, peer counselling); ed-tech/ed-services customer success or student-counselling freshers. Growth Path Strong performers with consistent NPS ownership and tracker discipline are the natural pipeline into the Student Relationship Senior Manager role as regions expand.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
About the Role Pump Academy Private Limited (PAPL) is seeking an experienced and self-driven Senior Systems Administrator to strengthen and manage its multi-site IT infrastructure. The incumbent will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, maintenance, and security of hardware, software, cloud platforms, and network assets across PAPL's office locations. This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role requiring the ability to independently manage IT operations under a formal Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned to ISO 27001:2022, while ensuring compliance with applicable legal and regulatory frameworks including the Information Technology Act, 2000. 
 Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Systems Administration Plan, deploy, configure, and maintain Windows/Linux servers (physical and virtual) across primary and branch office locations. Administer and support virtualisation environments (VMware / Hyper-V) and ensure high availability of critical systems. Manage storage systems, backup solutions, and disaster recovery (DR) procedures; conduct and document periodic DR drills. Maintain system and server documentation, asset registers, and configuration records in the ITSM/ITAM platform. Coordinate hardware procurement, vendor engagement, and warranty/AMC tracking for all IT assets. 
 Cloud Administration (AWS & Azure) Administer Microsoft Azure environments including Azure AD (Entra ID), Intune, conditional access, and identity governance. Manage AWS workloads EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch ensuring cost optimisation and security best practices. Implement and maintain cloud security controls, access policies, and resource tagging standards. Support hybrid cloud integration between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms. 
 Microsoft 365 Administration Manage the full Microsoft 365 tenant: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Intune MDM/MAM. Administer licensing, mailbox configuration, retention policies, DLP rules, and conditional access policies. Provide Level 2/3 support for Microsoft Teams voice, channels, meetings, and telephony integration. Conduct periodic M365 security assessments using Microsoft Secure Score and Defender for Office 365. 
 Network Infrastructure Configure, monitor, and maintain firewalls (Fortinet / SonicWall / Cisco ASA or equivalent), VPNs, and perimeter security. Manage Layer 2/3 switching infrastructure — VLAN segmentation, STP, inter-VLAN routing, and port security. Administer and troubleshoot Wi-Fi access points — configuration, coverage planning, captive portal, and guest network isolation. Monitor network performance using SNMP-based or equivalent NMS tools; respond to alerts and capacity issues proactively. Manage ISP links, WAN failover, and QoS configurations across multiple sites. 
 Physical & Peripheral Infrastructure Maintain and support printers, MFDs, scanners, and print server configurations for all offices. Manage CCTV/IP surveillance systems — installation, health checks, footage retention policy, and NVR administration. Oversee structured cabling, patch panel management, and rack organisation standards. Maintain UPS, PDUs, and server room environmental monitoring systems. 
 Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance Operate within the organisation's ISMS framework; implement and maintain controls per ISO 27001:2022 Annex A requirements. Participate in internal audits, risk assessments, and VAPT activities; track and close non-conformities and OFIs. Enforce endpoint security — EDR/antivirus deployment, patch management, USB control, and device hardening baselines. Administer identity and access management (IAM) — provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access control, and periodic access reviews. Assist in preparation of audit evidence, SOA mappings, and control documentation for external ISO audits. Support implementation of the IT Act 2000 and DPDP Act 2023 obligations including data classification, retention, and incident reporting. 
 IT Support & Service Management Act as an escalation point for Level 2 and Level 3 helpdesk incidents; mentor junior IT support staff. Log, track, and close incidents, service requests, and change requests in the ITSM platform per defined SLAs. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions. Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge base articles, and runbooks for all administered systems. 
 Multi-Site Operations & Travel Perform periodic on-site visits to branch offices for infrastructure audits, hardware refresh, and support activities. Coordinate with branch IT contacts to ensure consistency of configurations and security baselines across all locations. Plan and execute equipment deployments, network changes, and site upgrades with minimal business disruption. 
 Required Qualifications & Skills Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline. Relevant professional certifications are strongly preferred (see below). 
 Experience 5 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure administration within a corporate or enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience managing IT under an ISO 27001-certified ISMS — mandatory. Experience supporting multi-site, multi-user environments with diverse hardware and software stacks. 
 Technical Skills — Mandatory Microsoft 365 Administration (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Azure AD / Entra ID). Firewall administration — policy management, VPN configuration, zone-based security (any major vendor). AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud platform administration. Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) — AD DS, DNS, DHCP, GPO, file services, and print services. Network switches — VLAN, spanning tree, 802.1X, port mirroring, QoS. Wireless access point administration — enterprise-grade (Cisco/Ruckus/UniFi or equivalent). CCTV/IP camera systems — NVR configuration, retention policy enforcement, health monitoring. Endpoint management — patch management, EDR deployment, device compliance policy. Peripheral device management — printers, MFDs, and print servers. Backup and recovery tools — configuration, monitoring, and DR testing. 
 Technical Skills — Good to Have Linux server administration (Ubuntu / RHEL / CentOS). Scripting for automation — PowerShell, Bash, or Python. SIEM/log management tools — Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or equivalent. MDM/MAM solutions — Microsoft Intune or JAMF. ITSM platforms — ServiceNow, Freshservice, or in-house equivalents. Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) and AV integration administration. 
 Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge Working knowledge of the Information Technology Act, 2000 and its amendments. Familiarity with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. Understanding of ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls and audit processes. Awareness of ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 as they relate to IT process interfaces (preferred, not mandatory).

Monitor open orders and proactively liquidate backlog by resolving holds, coordinating material availability and escalating delivery risks with clear ownership and follow-up. Provide responsive customer communication on order status, delivery commitments, documentation and issue resolution, while supporting customer satisfaction and continuous process improvement. Working experience with an enterprise resource planning system, preferably Oracle, and a field service or service management platform such as ServiceMax; proficiency in standard office productivity tools Excel and operational reporting. It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in Life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices or another regulated customer-service environment. Local vendor coordination, backlog reduction, quotation management and proforma invoice processing.

title: AI VIDEO EDITOR BANGALORE
description:
Job Summary Kuku FM is looking for an AI Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it's about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one. You'll work across live-action + AI-generated content in a fast-paced, high-volume episodic production environment. Responsibilities Storytelling & Editing Edit live-action and AI-generated micro-dramas for mobile-first audiences. Create powerful opening hooks, emotional peaks, reveals, twists, payoffs, and cliffhangers. Shape dialogue, performances, music, SFX, voiceovers, and visuals into compelling narratives. Select the strongest takes to maximise emotion, conflict, suspense, and character relationships. Maintain strong pacing, visual rhythm, dialogue clarity, narrative progression, and audience retention. Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing. Mobile-First Storytelling Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing. Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact. Understand how to optimise storytelling for short attention spans and binge consumption. AI Video & VFX Work confidently with AI-generated characters, environments, performances, and shots. Identify and fix AI-video issues such as facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, flickering, warping, unnatural movement, frame instability, and continuity issues. Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement. Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated. Visual & Sound Finishing Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching. Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required. Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact. Ensure clear audio balance across mobile devices and viewing environments. Production & Collaboration Maintain story, character, costume, location, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and performance continuity. Manage multiple episodes, revisions, and priorities in a fast-moving production pipeline. Collaborate with directors, writers, creative producers, AI artists, and sound designers. Implement feedback accurately and meet tight delivery timelines. Maintain organised project files, proxies, media libraries, naming conventions, version histories, templates, and archival masters. Perform creative and technical QC and deliver final episodes to required platform, codec, resolution, frame-rate, aspect-ratio, and audio specifications. What We're Looking For Must Have 2-5 years of professional video-editing experience, preferably in fiction, micro-dramas, web series, films, TV, advertising, digital entertainment, or narrative short-form content. Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, dramatic pacing, emotional editing, and technical polish. Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills. Advanced Adobe after Effects skills, including compositing, masking, and tracking, cleanup, and motion graphics. Strong knowledge of Gen AI tool - Runaway, ElevanLabs, Kling, Veo, Adobe Firefly, Topaz or equivalent Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve for colour correction, grading, finishing, and media management. Strong understanding of narrative structure, screen direction, continuity, performance selection, montage, shot progression, and visual rhythm. Experience editing dialogue-driven scenes, romance, emotional sequences, action, confrontations, reveals, and cliffhangers. Strong understanding of audience retention and mobile-first 9:16 storytelling. Experience working with both live-action and AI-generated footage. Strong understanding of sound editing, dialogue balancing, music placement, ambience, Foley, and SFX. Ability to colour-match footage from different cameras, tools, and production pipelines. Strong eye for character, facial, costume, prop, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and background continuity. Ability to manage multiple episodes, revisions, and deadlines in a high-volume production environment. AI Experience Experience with generative AI video/image, lip-sync, cleanup, enhancement, upscaling, interpolation, shot extension, and compositing workflows is highly preferred. Preferred Qualifications Fluent Hindi and working proficiency in English. Experience with micro-dramas, vertical dramas, episodic fiction, web series, or retention-driven entertainment. Experience in fast-turnaround, high-volume episodic production. Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing, localisation, and multilingual versioning. Knowledge of proxy workflows, shared storage, media relinking, project templates, automated syncing, and structured post-production handoffs. Basic understanding of OTT and digital-platform delivery standards. Film editing, filmmaking, media production, animation, or related degree/diploma is a plus, but not mandatory.

title: General Manager Administration & Operations (Construction)
description:
Office General Manager Civil Construction 
 Company: Vijaya Enterprises
 Industry: Civil Construction & Real Estate
 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
 Working Hours: 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM
 Salary: 40,000 - 50,000 per month
 Experience: Experienced candidates preferred; 15+ years of relevant experience is desirable 
 About Vijaya Enterprises Vijaya Enterprises is an established civil construction and real estate company with more than 50 years of industry experience . We are looking for a mature, disciplined and dependable Office General Manager who can take responsibility for the day-to-day administration and coordination of our office and construction-related activities. This position is particularly suited to someone who brings substantial professional and life experience , strong discipline and the ability to independently manage people, administrative matters and routine operational responsibilities. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Office Administration Manage the day-to-day functioning of the office. Ensure office discipline, punctuality and smooth coordination between staff and management. Handle routine administrative matters and follow up on pending activities. Maintain office records, documents and important files. Coordinate with contractors, vendors, suppliers and other external parties as required. Ensure that important tasks and commitments are followed up and completed on time. 
 2. Accounts & Financial Administration Supervise basic day-to-day accounts and financial administration. Monitor payments, receipts, expenses and outstanding amounts. Coordinate with the accountant/CA and provide necessary information and documentation. Maintain records of office and project-related expenses. Follow up on supplier bills, payments and pending accounts. Basic understanding of accounting software and computer applications is preferred. 
 3. Staff Management Supervise office staff and ensure punctuality, discipline and proper work practices. Allocate and follow up on routine responsibilities. Monitor attendance and staff requirements. Ensure that employees complete assigned work within the required timelines. Act as a point of coordination between management and office staff. 
 4. Construction & Site Coordination Have a basic practical understanding of civil construction and building materials . Coordinate with site personnel and management regarding day-to-day requirements. Ensure that site-related requirements are communicated and followed up promptly. Monitor important timelines and ensure that site activities are not unnecessarily delayed. Where required, coordinate with suppliers and ensure that materials reach the site on time. 
 5. Purchase & Supply Chain Coordination The candidate may also be involved in basic procurement and supply coordination for construction materials such as: Cement Paint Building blocks Steel and other construction materials Plumbing and electrical materials Other routine building and finishing materials 
 Responsibilities may include coordinating with suppliers, following up on orders and ensuring timely delivery to the required site. 
 Site & Time Management The candidate must be highly punctual and disciplined . Ensure that required personnel, materials and arrangements are in place before scheduled site activities. Reach the site/office at the required time whenever necessary. Anticipate potential delays and take timely action to prevent them. Follow up proactively rather than waiting for instructions. Understand that punctuality and timely coordination are critical in the construction industry. 
 Candidate Profile We are looking for a mature, responsible and experienced individual rather than someone selected purely on educational qualifications. 
 Our preference is for: Candidates aged 45 years and above . Candidates with substantial work and life experience. Strong discipline, punctuality and integrity. Good people-management and communication skills. Ability to work independently and take responsibility. Practical understanding of office administration. Basic computer knowledge, including email, MS Office/Excel and other routine office applications. Basic knowledge of civil construction and building materials. Ability to communicate effectively with staff, contractors, suppliers and site personnel. Candidates who are comfortable working in a traditional, professionally managed construction business. 
 Government / Public Sector Experience Candidates who have taken voluntary retirement (VRS) from government services or have retired from a government organisation are particularly welcome to apply, especially where they have demonstrated: Strong discipline and punctuality Administrative experience Staff-management experience Responsibility and accountability Experience handling records, accounts or departmental operations However, government experience is not mandatory . Candidates from the private sector and construction industry with strong practical experience are equally welcome. 
 Education Formal educational qualifications are not the primary selection criterion for this position. We value experience, maturity, discipline, reliability and practical knowledge more than academic qualifications. 
 Required Skills Office administration Staff supervision and management Basic accounts management Basic computer knowledge MS Excel / Word and email Vendor and supplier coordination Basic construction-material knowledge Site coordination Good communication skills Strong follow-up ability Punctuality and discipline 
 Personal Qualities We Value The ideal candidate should be: Disciplined • Punctual • Honest • Responsible • Practical • Dependable • Mature • Organised • Proactive 
 We are looking for someone who can become a trusted senior member of the organisation and handle day-to-day responsibilities with minimal supervision. 
 Location Requirement Candidates must be based in Bengaluru. The position requires regular attendance at the office from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM , with occasional site visits or site coordination as required. Candidates should be comfortable commuting to the office every working day and should not have any difficulty with the required working hours. 
 Compensation 40,000 50,000 per month , depending on experience, capability and suitability for the role.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit Operations
description:
Senior Analyst - Credit Operations 
 Responsibilities 
Own weekly reporting on the borrower funnel: Application Completion Rate, Offer Acceptance Rate, TAT, and stage-level drop-off. Root-cause funnel bottlenecks from registration to disbursal and propose fixes with sized impact. Own retention and repeat-borrower analysis: cohort trends, churn drivers, early-warning signals. Design and run retention tests, and report results against a stated baseline. Analyse collections performance - recovery rate by DPD bucket, in-house vs agency allocation, agent-level productivity - and hand the collections team ranked priorities. Run reconciliations across disbursements, repayments, and fund movements, clearing discrepancies with IT. Track tele-sales, support, and voicebot performance against target: FRT, CSAT, conversion throughput. Build and maintain the reporting and automation layer - SQL, dashboards, AI tooling - that turns raw data into decision-ready recommendations. 
 6-12 Month Expectations 
 Registration-to-Disbursal conversion improved by 5 percentage points, off the drop-off diagnostic that drove it. Month-on-month repeat-borrower retention held at 15% every month and reaching 20% by month 12, off a documented cohort and churn analysis. Reconciliation and the tele-sales readout (FRT, CSAT, conversion) running as standing processes, with zero unexplained discrepancies and zero SLA breaches. 
 Who We Are Looking For 
 3-5 years in business operations, product, or web/app analytics within digital consumer lending or a high-growth fintech. Hands-on SQL plus Python or Apps Script: writes and runs own queries against raw tables, builds automations with no dependency on an engineer. Advanced daily use of AI tools: drafting and stress-testing queries, running automations, building dashboards and readable reports. Broke down an ambiguous operational problem against large, messy data and defended the recommendation to the people who had to act on it. Written SOPs and process notes that a team then ran on. Working knowledge of the Indian digital lending ecosystem and core credit concepts: DPD buckets, disbursal flow, repayment and collection mechanics. Track record of switching between analysis and hands-on execution - this is not an advisory role. Fluent in English.

Key Skills: Credit Analysis,Credit Operations,Collections Analytics,Digital Lending,borrower funnel,Process Automation,Business Analytics,Fintech

description:

 Summary 
AI Powered Tech Talent. o Inspection Planning & Results Recording
o Quality Notifications & Corrective Actions
o Incoming, In Process, and Final Inspections
o Quality Certificates, Sampling Procedures, and Catalogs
o Integration with Procurement, Production, and Warehouse

Support end to end delivery across requirements, solution design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, and hypercare.
Integrate QM processes with MM, PP, WM/EWM, PM, SD, and vendor/customer facing systems.
AI Assisted Productivity

o Rapid requirement summarization
o Impact analysis on inspection types and quality workflows
o Auto generation of documentation (FS/TS/SOPs)
o Faster test case creation for various inspection scenarios
o Pattern detection in quality issues, defects, and notifications
Leverage pre built AI services for:
o Intelligent classification of defects and notifications
o Predictive quality signals (e.g., expected defect rates)
o Automated summarization of quality issues across plants/batches
Apply LLM assisted troubleshooting for quicker resolution of QM configuration or process issues.
Governance, Quality & Collaboration
Ensure all QM processes adhere to organizational quality standards, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and compliance frameworks.
Conduct workshops, solution walkthroughs, and root cause analysis using AI generated insights.
Collaborate with procurement, production, warehouse, engineering, quality labs, and technical integration teams.
Contribute to reusable templates, configuration accelerators, inspection plans, and AI enabled best practices.
 
Required Skills & Experience
SAP QM Expertise
Hands on experience with SAP QM including inspection types, quality notifications, inspection lots, usage decisions, catalogs, MICs, sample procedures, and control indicators.
Understanding of integration dependencies with MM (incoming inspection), PP (in process/production inspections), WM/EWM, SD, and vendor quality.
Experience with quality reports, certificates, and data analysis of inspection results.
AI Ready Skills
Experience using AI copilots, LLM driven documentation tools, and AI assisted testing/troubleshooting accelerators.
Ability to integrate pre built AI capabilities (not custom model/RAG development) into QM operations where appropriate.
Understanding of responsible AI usage, especially in regulated quality and manufacturing environments.
General Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to quality processes and defect patterns.
Ability to translate quality and manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP QM configurations.
Clear communication and collaboration skills across business and IT teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI augmented productivity workflows.
 
Good to Have
SAP QM Certification.
Exposure to LIMS systems, quality labs, or HACCP/GxP environments.
Knowledge of statistical quality control or manufacturing analytics.
Experience with automated testing tools or workflow automation platforms.
 
Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more accurate SAP QM solutions using AI assisted productivity enhancements.
Improve product quality, defect traceability, and compliance using quality data insights.
Act as a bridge between quality teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native teams when deeper AI involvement is required.

title: Senior Technical Service Advisor
description:
Senior Technical Service Advisor This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. What you ll do: Responsibilities: The two main aspect of the role would be to represent HPE Networking customer service to the customer and as representative of the customer back to Juniper. Act as a single point of contact for post-sales customer service issues in the account for the customer, partners, and account team. Understand customer lifecycle to deliver efficiency and effectiveness to the customer. Support the account/customer with alignment to services sales and product sales activities. Tracking and managing the deliverables of HPE Networking Foundation care, Advanced Care, Premium Care. Help support cases resolved as per SLAs and expedite/escalate critical issues among HPE Networking technical support teams. Provide relevant technical inputs to facilitate and expedite escalated problem resolution. Proactively escalates and brings people with required expertise together to bring critical and important issues to closure. Act as an interlock between Customer and HPE Networking Professional Services, Advanced Services and Education Services for the services to be delivered to the customer. Coordinate and oversee all customer service delivery into the account. This includes maintenance of the support plan for the account, in cooperation with the Service Business Manager (SBM). Early engagement regarding major projects to consider service requirements, risk management, and expectation setting with the account team, partners, and customer. Conduct Periodic reviews with customer to review Juniper service delivery metrics, SLA and quality. Establish a customer specific operational status and reporting framework (using ITIL), and lead in the delivery and presentation of status reports. Uses professional knowledge to review and assess open software defects. Discovers potential risks associated with the deployment plans and partner with the customer to develop mitigation plans. Delivers proactive consulting services such as technical analysis and recommendations (Impact assessment and analysis, health check analysis, software upgrade analysis, config review, etc ) Partners with Customers in conducting periodic Juniper product health checks to identify potential product improvement areas. Based on the evaluation makes a relevant recommendation to optimize operational performance with respect to design/topology/configuration. Reviews and evaluate network plan and assist in the planning of new feature implementation and product deployment. Allies with internal teams to resolve identified risks in software. Engages with HPE Networking engineering teams to improve potential quality issues with products. Document and maintain customer network solutions knowledge and educates other internal Juniper resources for a better support experience. Skill specifications The candidate is encouraged to have a deep understanding of core IP networking concepts (TCP/IP, QoS, VLAN, STP, IPSEC, NAT, IPv6). Should possess reasonable expertise in Layer2, Layer3 protocols such as VRRP, OSPF, BGP, Multicast, MPLS VPN. Knowledge and experience of the newest technologies such as Segment Routing, Traffic engineering, DC switching, VxLAN, EVPN, SD-WAN & Wireless is a plus. Experience working in large enterprises, Network service providers have added advantage. ITIL Framework process knowledge will be an added advantage. Experience and desire to work on automation will be valuable in long run. Amiable communication, interpersonal and social skills will make a difference! HPE Networking product certifications (HPE Aruba Networking - switching, Campus access, Data Center, HPE Juniper - JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP/JNCIE) or industry equivalents are helpful. What you need to bring: Education and Experience Required Bachelor s or master s degree in a relevant field. Around 8 - 12 years of experience, preferably in a router/switch company. Knowledge and Skills We generally prefer candidates with bachelor s degree in electrical/electronic Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. A Business degree such as MBA would be an advantage. 8+ years experience in designing, implementing, and solving technical problems of the state-of-the-art Datacenter, IP/MPLS- Networks. High exposure to network operations environment. Ability to operate independently, including management of priorities in unstructured environment with good communication skills.
