title: Windchill Consultant or Architect
description:
1. Windchill Process Consultant / PLM Functional Consultant Role: Windchill Process Consultant / PLM Functional Consultant Experience: 612 Years Locations: Bangalore | Chennai | Hyderabad | Mumbai | Pune | Noida Employment Type: Full-Time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Windchill Process Consultant / PLM Functional Consultant to work with business and IT stakeholders to analyze, define, and optimize PLM processes using PTC Windchill. The role requires strong functional expertise in Windchill PDMLink, with a deep understanding of engineering change processes, configuration and release governance, product structures, and BOM management. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding business requirements, translating them into functional specifications and Windchill solutions, and effectively bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 PLM & Windchill Process Consulting 
 Analyze existing PLM processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and standardization. Work with business stakeholders to understand engineering and product lifecycle requirements. Facilitate AS-IS and TO-BE process discussions/workshops. Design and recommend business processes aligned with Windchill capabilities. Translate business processes and requirements into clear functional specifications. Provide functional guidance on Windchill OOTB capabilities, configuration, and customization. Work closely with technical teams to ensure functional requirements are correctly understood and implemented. 
 Engineering Change & Release Management 
 Provide functional expertise in Engineering Change Management. Support processes covering Change Requests, Change Notices, reviews, approvals, and implementation. Define and optimize configuration and release governance. Understand product revisions, versions, lifecycle states, and controlled product releases. Ensure PLM processes support appropriate engineering and business governance. 
 Product Structure & BOM Management 
 Provide functional expertise in Product Structure and BOM Management. Understand engineering product structures and their relationship with Windchill Parts / WTParts. Support creation, maintenance, revision, and release of product structures and BOMs. Work with Engineering and Manufacturing stakeholders to ensure BOM processes meet business requirements. 
 Stakeholder & Business-IT Collaboration 
 Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and IT/technical teams. Conduct requirement-gathering sessions, workshops, walkthroughs, and solution discussions. Communicate complex PLM concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT teams. Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. 
 Documentation & Functional Analysis 
 Prepare: Business Requirements Functional Specifications Process Flows Business Process Documentation Solution Recommendations Analyze business requirements and assess their impact on existing PLM processes. Maintain structured documentation throughout the consulting lifecycle. Support functional validation of proposed Windchill solutions. 
 Mandatory Skills & Experience 
 6 to 12 years of experience in PLM / Windchill programs. Strong experience as a PLM Process Consultant or Windchill Functional Consultant. Strong hands-on experience with PTC Windchill. Windchill PDMLink experience is mandatory. Deep understanding of: Engineering Change Management Configuration Management Release Management / Release Governance Product Structure Management BOM Management Ability to translate business processes and requirements into functional specifications. Strong understanding of PLM business processes and their implementation within Windchill. Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to effectively bridge Business and IT. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent documentation and communication skills. Collaborative and customer-focused approach. 
 Good to Have 
 Windchill MPMLink Windchill PartsLink Windchill Supplier Management (SUMA) Manufacturing BOM / M-BOM processes PLM process transformation and optimization 
 Preferred Domain Experience

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM) and proven experience delivering end-to-end Windchill migration programs, including migration strategy, source-to-target mapping, data validation, rehearsal migrations, production cutover, and hypercare. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Migration Strategy & Planning 
 Define overall Windchill data migration strategy, scope, and sequencing. Conduct source-to-target mapping workshops with business and IT stakeholders. Finalize migration approach including: Rehearsal strategy Delta migration strategy Validation approach Cutover plan Assess migration risks, dependencies, data quality, and technical constraints. 
 Source System Assessment 
 Assess source PLM systems including: Windchill Agile Teamcenter Custom PLM systems Define data mapping and transformation rules. Identify: Data conflicts Duplicates Inconsistencies Data-quality issues Establish appropriate data cleansing and transformation approaches. 
 Windchill Bulk Migration 
 Lead end-to-end migration using Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM). Plan and execute multiple migration rehearsals such as: RH-1 RH-2 RH-3 Production Migration Define migration sequencing and dependencies. Support delta migration and production cutover activities. 
 Migration Validation & Governance 
 Define migration validation strategy, KPIs, and acceptance criteria. Support and govern business validation cycles after each rehearsal. Drive: Defect identification Defect resolution Migration re-runs Fix verification Data reconciliation Support go-live, cutover weekend, and hypercare activities. 
 Technical Leadership 
 Provide technical guidance to Migration Consultants and Developers. Review and approve: Migration scripts SQL transformations Migration utilities Data transformation logic Work closely with: Functional teams CAD teams Integration teams Infrastructure teams Business stakeholders Ensure complete migration documentation and knowledge transfer. 
 Mandatory Skills & Experience 
 10 to 15 years of experience in PLM, with strong migration-focused experience. Very strong hands-on expertise in Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM). Proven experience in multiple end-to-end Windchill migration programs. At least one non-Windchill Windchill migration experience is mandatory. Deep understanding of: Windchill Object Model Object relationships Parts BOMs Documents CAD Change data Lifecycles Versions Iterations Strong SQL skills with Oracle / SQL Server. Experience with large-volume data analysis and transformation. Strong understanding of source-to-target mapping and data validation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent client communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 Preferred Domain Experience 
 Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred: Manufacturing Industrial Automotive Medical Devices

 We are looking for an experienced Windchill Customization / Application Development Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Windchill development, customization, configuration, APIs, integrations, and application delivery. The candidate should have strong knowledge of Windchill server-side and client-side customization, Java/J2EE, SQL, scripting, REST APIs, lifecycle/workflow configuration, and DevOps practices. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Support continuous deployment and automated delivery processes. Deploy and debug Windchill code through established build and deployment processes. 
 Agile Delivery & Collaboration 
 Work closely with onshore/offshore Business Architects and Solution Architects. Support technical teams in developing prototypes and full-scale solutions. Work effectively within an Agile / Scrum delivery model. Collaborate with functional, technical, infrastructure, and integration teams. Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and solution walkthroughs. 
 Mandatory Skills & Experience 
 810 years of experience in Windchill development. Strong hands-on experience with PTC Windchill. Strong knowledge of Windchill server-side and client-side customization using Windchill APIs mandatory. Strong knowledge of Windchill database architecture. Strong knowledge of: Java / J2EE SQL Scripting Strong experience with Windchill Lifecycle and Workflow configuration/customization. Experience developing solutions aligned with business process requirements. Experience with Windchill REST APIs. Good understanding of DevOps approaches and methodologies. Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery environments.

 Experience in Medical Devices domain. Experience with QMS / Regulatory processes. Windchill MPMLink. Windchill PartsLink. REST services using OData / Swagger. CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.

title: Gimbal Design Engineer
description:
Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Gimbal Hardware Engineer with strong expertise in electromechanical integration, hardware design, and ruggedized system development. The ideal candidate will focus on the physical and electrical hardware aspects of gimbal systems, ensuring reliability in harsh environmental conditions. This role is suited for a hands-on hardware specialist who excels in connectors, harnessing, sealing, thermal management, and system-level integration of gimbal subsystems. Key Responsibilities Hardware Design & Integration Design and develop robust hardware architecture for 2-axis/3-axis gimbal systems. Integrate motors, sensors, cameras, PCBs, and wiring subsystems into compact and reliable assemblies. Ensure proper mechanical-electrical interfacing, grounding, and shielding practices. Connectors, Harness & Wiring Select and validate connectors (circular, micro-D, board-to-board, rugged connectors) based on application requirements. Design and develop wiring harnesses, including routing, strain relief, and serviceability. Ensure compliance with communication protocol harness standards for: o UART, RS232, RS485 o Ethernet / IP-based systems o Video signal transmission (HDMI, LVDS, MIPI, etc.) Perform signal integrity and EMI/EMC considerations in harness design. Environmental Protection & Sealing Design systems to meet IP ratings (IP65/IP67/IP68) for dust and water resistance. Select and implement gaskets, O-rings, sealing compounds, and potting materials. Ensure proper waterproofing and environmental sealing across enclosures, connectors, and cable interfaces. Collaborate on shock, vibration, and environmental robustness requirements. Thermal Management Analyze and implement thermal solutions including: 1) Heatsinks. 2) Thermal pads and interface materials. 3) Passive cooling strategies Ensure optimal heat dissipation for motors, electronics, and embedded systems. Motor & Hardware Component Selection Select appropriate gimbal motors (BLDC / torque motors) based on mechanical and electrical constraints. Evaluate hardware components such as fasteners, brackets, housings, and mounting interfaces. Understand mechanical load paths and ensure structural integrity. Testing & Validation Conduct hardware validation tests, including: 1) Waterproofing/IP tests 2) Vibration and shock testing 3) Thermal performance validation Troubleshoot hardware-related issues across connectors, wiring, and packaging. Support field testing and failure analysis. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electrical / Electronics Engineering or related field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in hardware design for rugged electromechanical systems. Strong understanding of: 1) Connectors and harness design 2) IP ratings and sealing techniques 3) Hardware integration in compact systems Proficiency in CAD tools and mechanical design fundamentals. Ability to interpret technical datasheets and standards. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Experience in UAV payloads, gimbals, or defense/aerospace hardware systems. Knowledge of EMI/EMC design considerations. Familiarity with industrial/military connector standards (MIL-spec). Experience with thermal simulation tools. Exposure to manufacturing processes and vendor coordination.

Key Skills: Gimbal Hardware Design,EMI/EMC,Ruggedized Systems,Connector Selection,Electromechanical Integration,CAD,Hardware Component Selection,Thermal Management

Exposure to Automotive PMICs. Experience with High Voltage (HV) and Low Voltage (LV) devices.
